content: The underground mining equipment market has been recognized for its significant growth potential, with projections estimating its global valuation at 45.2 billion by 2025, and further expected growth to 72.9 billion by 2033, reflecting a compound annual growth rate of 6.4 percent [51] . Other forecasts anticipate even more aggressive expansion, projecting the market size to reach 229.20 billion by 2035, driven by heightened demand where coal accounts for a large share of 39 percent by application, alongside a remarkable forecasted compound annual growth rate of 15.3 percent from 2026 to 2035 [3] . Additional industry analyses reiterate these future growth patterns, predicting that the broader mining equipment market will expand at a compound annual growth rate of 5.8 percent between 2026 and 2032 [53] . Earlier projections similarly suggested that the global market size for mining equipment was anticipated to reach 133.2 billion by the year 2026, growing at a steady rate of 5.00 percent during the 2022 to 2026 period [1] . These forward-looking market dynamics are heavily influenced by technological advancements in mining processes, increasing environmental concerns, and shifting demands linked to renewable energy and critical minerals. Consequently, as global demand for mining equipment and associated wear parts intensifies, Alpha Industries SA must anticipate continued volatility in import lead times and competitive pressures on international supplier capacities. For instance, Metso introduced new crusher wear parts in early 2023, which were specifically designed to enhance operational efficiency by extending service life and reducing equipment downtime [53] . These product improvements are key factors in enhancing overall supply chain reliability, as longer-lasting wear parts directly reduce the frequency of required imports and the associated logistical expenditures. Furthermore, addressing the geographical constraints of the supply chain, Metso invested 4 million in increasing its manufacturing capacity within Africa, with specific attention directed toward meeting the demand in South Africa [49] . Ultimately, by integrating advanced wear part technologies that require less frequent replacement and capitalizing on regionally manufactured components, Alpha Industries SA can effectively navigate the complexities of the current import dynamics, stabilize its logistics expenditures, and maintain a highly competitive and uninterrupted mining operation.
